paths.path: Dolphin.ini, GCPadNew.ini, WiimoteNew.ini, GCKeyNew.ini and Profiles/GCPad/*.ini + Profiles/Wiimote/*.ini under ~/.config/dolphin-emu/Config/ (XDG_CONFIG_HOME); the remaining user trees (GameSettings/<game id>[r<rev>].ini overlays, GC, Wii, StateSaves) root at ~/.local/share/dolphin-emu; a legacy monolithic ~/.dolphin-emu is used when it exists and /.flatpak-info is absent; portable.txt next to the binary or $DOLPHIN_EMU_USERPATH redirect the whole root (portable dir is named user)
paths.naming: Controller INI syntax: [GCPad1..4]/[Wiimote1..4] or Profiles/GCPad|Wiimote [Profile] sections with Device/Buttons/A/Triggers/L-Analog group-control keys; profile references are comma-separated PadProfileN values

controller syntax: pad sections [GCPad1..4]/[Wiimote1..4] and profile [Profile] sections serialize Device = <backend>/<index>/<devicename> plus group/control keys Buttons/A, D-Pad/Up, Main Stick/Up, C-Stick/Up, Triggers/L, Triggers/L-Analog with optional <key>/Range — ControllerEmu.cpp 'Device' key, ControlGroup/ControlGroup.cpp expression/Range keys, HW/GCPadEmu.h group names @6094cfcf

paths.path: raw GC memory cards at ~/.local/share/dolphin-emu/GC/MemoryCardA.<region>.raw (slot B: MemoryCardB), GCI-folder mode at GC/<region>/Card A (slot B: Card B), Wii save data under ~/.local/share/dolphin-emu/Wii/title/00010000/<title-id-low>/data/
paths.naming: MemoryCardA/MemoryCardB + .USA/.EUR/.JAP + optional .<blocks> for non-251-block cards + .raw (e.g. GC/MemoryCardA.USA.raw); GCI-folder saves are <maker>-<game code>-<internal filename>.gci (e.g. 01-GALE01-....gci) under GC/<region>/Card A; Wii disc-title saves live at Wii/title/00010000/<lower title id>/data (TitleType::Game = 0x00010000)

paths.path: ~/.local/share/dolphin-emu/StateSaves/
paths.naming: <game id>.s<slot 01-10> for both GameCube and Wii (e.g. StateSaves/GALE01.s01), plus lastState.sav and undo.dtm; there is no .gci/.gcs state format — .gci is a memory-card save image

paths.path: optional GC IPL dumps at ~/.local/share/dolphin-emu/GC/<USA|EUR|JAP>/IPL.bin (region-specific file, not a single GC/IPL.bin; falls back to the shipped Sys/GC/<region>/IPL.bin); Wii requires no firmware dump
paths.naming: Optional GameCube IPL dump is exactly IPL.bin under the region directory USA, EUR, or JAP; Wii has no external firmware filename and no canonical checksum is declared

source:CommonPaths.h GC_IPL=IPL.bin, GC_SYS_DIR, EUR/USA/JAP region dirs @6094cfcf

paths.path: none user-supplied: Wii root keys and the default ECC private key are compiled into the emulator, and the emulated NAND under Wii/ is generated, not dumped
paths.naming: No external key filename: Wii root/default ECC key material is compiled into Dolphin and the emulated NAND is generated
